description: Send one real file — a document such as a PDF, an image, or a video — from the workspace's WhatsApp number into one WhatsApp group, after the user confirms. Every member of that group receives it and it cannot be recalled. `file_url` must be a DIRECT url to the file: if the file is a Google Drive / Dropbox share link, or only exists as bytes you generated, call upload_file first (pass the link as `source_url`) and use the url and filename it returns. Works on a number connected by QR code, and on an official green-tick Cloud API number (not Coexistence) for groups created with Meta's Groups API (their chat_id contains letters). Identify the group with "group_id", set to the group's "chat_id" from get_groups (e.g. 120363041234567890@g.us); "chat_id" is accepted as an alias. Group names are not accepted. One group per call: not a broadcast tool. For text only, use send_group_message.

caption.description: Optional text shown with the file in the group.

chat_id.description: Alias of "group_id", accepted because get_groups calls this value "chat_id". Pass the group in "group_id" OR "chat_id", not both.

confirm.description: Consent gate — REQUIRED on every call. Pass false first: the tool then performs no action and returns a preview of exactly what would happen. Show that preview to the user, get their explicit approval, and only then call again with true to post this file into the group.

file_url.description: Direct https url of the file — typically the `url` returned by upload_file. Not a Drive/Dropbox/OneDrive share page.

filename.description: Display name INCLUDING the extension (e.g. "proposal.pdf") — pass the `filename` upload_file returned. WhatsApp uses the extension to pick the file type, so a name without one arrives as an unopenable "BIN" attachment and is refused. Required whenever file_url has no filename in its path.

group_id.description: The group's "chat_id" exactly as returned by get_groups (e.g. 120363041234567890@g.us), for ONE group. The digits without @g.us are also accepted. Group names and the numeric "id" field are refused. This is the preferred argument.

media_type.description: How WhatsApp shows it: "document" (default — a downloadable file with its name, right for PDFs and office files), "image" (shown inline; jpg/png/webp) or "video" (played inline; mp4).

name: send_group_file
